header.title: THE GENESIS DEMO, 1982
header.credit: W. T. Reeves, Lucasfilm Ltd — "Particle Systems: A Technique for Modeling a Class of Fuzzy Objects", SIGGRAPH '83 / ACM TOG 2(2) · sequence dir. Alvy Ray Smith · Star Trek II, Paramount, June 4, 1982

census.head: PARTICLE CENSUS — REEVES 1983 §3
census.footnote: * FIG. 4 IS "ONE VERY LARGE PARTICLE SYSTEM AND ABOUT 20 SMALLER ONES" — THAT MEAN IS MEANINGLESS.
census.note: NO PARAMETER VALUE IS PUBLISHED ANYWHERE. EVERY CONSTANT HERE IS ARITHMETIC ON TWO PUBLISHED INTEGERS: 85,000 ÷ 200 = 425 ALIVE PER EXPLOSION (FIG. 6), AND POPULATION = BIRTH RATE × LIFETIME — PICK MeanLife = 34 f AND THE RATE FOLLOWS. SYSTEMS IGNITE EVERY 18.5/168 = 0.110 s: 20 GENERATING + 13 BURNING OUT = 24 FULLY-LIT EQUIVALENTS. A LIMB VIEW STACKS THE RING IN DEPTH (FIG. 6 IS ~200 SYSTEMS; THIS SLICE ANCHORS 53 COLUMNS), SO EACH COLUMN CARRIES 3: 72 × 425 = 30,600 PREDICTED. THE "THIS" ROW IS MEASURED.

ramp.head: COLOUR IS OVERLAP COUNT
ramp.note: LIGHT ADDS AND CLAMPS (§2.5) — RED SATURATES AT n=5, GREEN AT n=20, BLUE AT n=111. e₀ = (0.220, 0.050, 0.009) IS THE ONE RECONSTRUCTED SEED.

render.head: RENDER MODEL — THREE PATHS, ONE POOL
render.note: SAME 700 PARTICLES, ONE POOL. LEFT AND CENTRE DIFFER ONLY IN BLEND: kSrcOver CANNOT ACCUMULATE, SO ITS WHOLE PALETTE IS LUT ENTRY n=1. ALL THREE ARE STREAKED SPHERICAL — LENGTH 0.5·|v|, WIDTH size. THE TWO POOLS TAKE IT FROM Pool::sizes(), THE OPT-IN NON-UNIFORM LANE THAT STRETCHES ONE BAKED CELL PER INSTANCE.
